certificate.module_name: Palo Alto Networks SD-WAN ION Core Crypto Module
certificate.caveat: When installed, initialized and configured as specified in Section 11.1 of the Security Policy
certificate.description: The Palo Alto Networks SD-WAN ION Core Crypto Module is utilized in hardware and software ION form factors. These enable the integration of a diverse set of wide area network (WAN) connection types, improve application performance and visibility, enhance security and compliance, and reduce the overall cost and complexity of a WAN.
